name: Whisper ASR
description: OpenAI Whisper as an HTTP service: transcribe audio files via a simple REST API or the bundled web page. Great for automating transcriptions.
compose:
services:
  whisper:
    image: onerahmet/openai-whisper-asr-webservice:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:9000"
    environment:
      ASR_MODEL: "base"
      ASR_ENGINE: "faster_whisper"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/root/.cache/whisper
    restart: unless-stopped
